lead: Joe Root is best known as a British cricketer, born on 30 December 1990 in Dore.
As of 2026, he is 35 years old, and his birth date places him under the Capricorn sign.
He has represented England cricket team and Yorkshire County Cricket Club and has been recognised with Wisden Cricketer of the Year and Member of the Order of the British Empire.
This profile collects the Joe facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
